title: C# syntax basics: names, operators, control flow, and directives
summary: Learn the grammar of C#: how to name things, write expressions with operators (including C# 14 null-conditional assignment), branch with if and switch, repeat with loops, jump with break and return, guard overflow with checked, and use compiler directives. This is the vocabulary you read in every service before object-oriented programming.

topics.title: Names, reserved words, and typed values (identifiers, keywords, literals)
Expressions and operators (arithmetic, logic, null handling)
Decision flow with if and switch statements
Repeating work with for, while, and foreach loops
Changing flow with break, continue, return, and goto
Special operators: overflow checks, nameof, and sizeof
